I was studying English at a language school, and I was living in a homestay.
I did a homestay in Spain in college. It was the best part of the whole year.

That happened to me in Seattle last year. I was looking for my hotel and the battery just died.
While I was looking for a bus stop, I ran into a classmate from Colombia.
What luck! So he took you home?

Hi, I am Rachel, and this is my worst travel day. I was flying from Seattle to Vancouver for a conference. While I was waiting at the gate, they announced that the flight was canceled. Everybody ran to the desk. I was standing in the line when the man behind me offered to share a rental car. It sounds crazy, but I said yes. We were driving north along the coast when the sun came up, and it turned out to be the most beautiful morning of my life. I missed the first day of the conference, but I have never regretted it.

Hi Thiago, it is Mark, your host dad. I just want to tell you what happened this afternoon, because you were at school. I was cooking dinner when the power went out in the whole street. While I was looking for candles, the neighbors knocked on the door and invited us to a cookout in their backyard. So we ended up eating there, and it was a lot of fun. When you get home, do not go to our house, it is completely dark. Come next door, to the blue house. There is a plate of food waiting for you.

First, Thiago was living in a homestay and studying at a language school. Then, on his first Saturday, he went sightseeing and got lost. Finally, they ended up in a small restaurant, and it turned out to be the best night of the trip.
